## Tone

It's also common to see tone transcribed with small superscript numbers between 1 and 5.

::: {.ipa style="font-size: 2em;text-align: center;"}
\[ma^35^\] vs \[ma^13^\]
:::

## Vowel Variation In Englishes

Back vowel fronting

|                     |                      |                |                     |
|---------------------|----------------------|----------------|---------------------|
| [Goose]{.smallcaps} | [\[ɨu ɨʉ y\]]{.ipa}  | [\[uɫ\]]{.ipa} | [Ghoul]{.smallcaps} |
| [Goat]{.smallcaps}  | \[[əʊ əʉ ø]{.ipa}\]  | [\[oɫ\]]{.ipa} | [Goal]{.smallcaps}  |
| [Mouth]{.smallcaps} | [\[aʊ æʊ ɛɔ\]]{.ipa} |                | [Foul]{.smallcaps}  |

## Vowel Variation in Englishes

::: {.content-hidden when-format="typst"}

::: {.cell}

```{typst}
#import "@preview/phonokit:0.5.15": *
#phonokit-init(font: "Noto Sans")

#sound-shift(
  nodes: (
    (label: "I",    at: (0, 6)),
    (label: "E",    at: (1, 3.0)),
    (label: "2",    at: (8, 3.0)),    
    (label: "\\ae", at: (3, 0)),
    (label: "A", at: (8, -1)),
    (label: "i:", at: (-2, 8)),
    (label: "eI", at: (-1, 4)),
    (label: "u:", at: (10,8)),
    (label: "u: \\darkl", at: (12,8)),    
    (label: "oU", at: (10, 4)),  
    (label: "oU \\darkl", at: (12, 4)),      
    (label: "U",    at: (8, 6)),
  ),
  arrows: (
    (from: "u:", to: (2,8)),
    (from: "oU", to: (3.5,4)),
    (from: "U", to: (3.7, 6)),
    (from: "2", to: (3.9, 3))
  )
)

```
:::

## Vowel Variation in Englishes

pre-l laxing

|               |                            |                  |                |
|---------------|----------------------------|------------------|----------------|
| "peat", "pit" | [\[pʰit\], \[pʰɪt\]]{.ipa} | [\[pʰɪɫ\]]{#ipa} | "peel", "pill" |
| "poot", "put" | [\[pʰut\], \[pʰʊt\]]{.ipa} | \[[pʰʊɫ]{.ipa}\] | "pool", "pull" |

## Vowel Variation in Englishes

"Short-a" \~stuff\~

|        |                 |                  |        |
|--------|-----------------|------------------|--------|
| "rap"  | [\[ɹæp\]]{.ipa} | [\[ɹɛ̃ᵊm\]]{.ipa} | "ram"  |
| "mat"  | [\[mæt\]]{.ipa} | [\[mɛ̃ᵊn\]]{.ipa} | "man"  |
| "back" | [\[bæk\]]{.ipa} | [\[bɛ̃ᵊŋ\]]{.ipa} | "bang" |

## Vowel Variation in Englishes

Short vowel lowering

::: {.content-hidden when-format="typst"}

::: {.cell}

```{typst}
#import "@preview/phonokit:0.5.15": *
#phonokit-init(font: "Noto Sans")

#sound-shift(
  nodes: (
    (label: "I",    at: (0, 6)),
    (label: "E",    at: (1, 3.0)),
    (label: "2",    at: (8, 3.0)),    
    (label: "\\ae", at: (3, 0)),
    (label: "A", at: (8, -1)),
    (label: "i:", at: (-2, 8)),
    (label: "eI", at: (-1, 4)),
    (label: "u:", at: (10,8)),
    (label: "oU", at: (10, 4)),  
    (label: "U",    at: (8, 6)),
  ),
  arrows: (
    (from: "\\ae", to: (7,-0.8), curved: true, curve: -0.15),
    (from: "E", to: "\\ae", curved: true, curve: -0.15),
    (from: "I", to: "E", curved: true, curve: -0.15)
  )
)

```
:::

| "type" | [\[tʰɑɪp\]]{.ipa} | [\[tʰʌip\]]{.ipa} | [\[tʰɑɪp\]]{.ipa} | [\[tʰaːp\]]{.ipa} | [\[tʰʌip\]]{.ipa} |
| "time" | [\[tʰɑɪm\]]{.ipa} | [\[tʰɑɪm\]]{.ipa} | [\[tʰaːm\]]{.ipa} | [\[tʰaːm\]]{.ipa} | [\[tʰaːm\]]{.ipa} |

## Vowel Variation in Englishes

The Southern Shift

::: {.content-hidden when-format="typst"}

::: {.cell}

```{typst}
#import "@preview/phonokit:0.5.15": *
#phonokit-init(font: "Noto Sans")

#sound-shift(
  nodes: (
    (label: "I",    at: (0, 6)),  
    (label: "E",    at: (1, 3.0)),
    (label: "2",    at: (8, 3.0)),    
    (label: "\\ae", at: (3, 0)),
    (label: "A", at: (8, -1)),
    (label: "i:", at: (-2, 8)),   
    (label: "eI", at: (-1, 4)),
    (label: "u:", at: (10,8)),
    (label: "oU", at: (10, 4)),  
    (label: "U",    at: (8, 6)),
    (label: "AI", at: (5,-1))
  ),
  arrows: (
    (from: "AI", to: "A"),
    (from: "eI", to: (3,-1), curved: true, curve: -0.2),
    (from: "i:", to: "eI", curved: true, curve: -0.2),
    (from: "I", to: "i:", curved: true, curve: -0.2),
    (from: "E", to: "eI", curved: true, curve: -0.2)        
  )
)
```
